steps.text: call Compile, on error call HandleBuildFailure
build.fold Goal=%goal%, on error call HandleBuildFailure
if %itemCount% is 0, write out "Your cart is empty", else if %itemCount% is 1, write out "One item", else write out "%itemCount% items"
if %order.email% does not contain "@", throw "Invalid email address"
if %order.coupon% is not empty, call ApplyCoupon code=%order.coupon%, order=%order%
if %order.total% is not a number, throw "The total must be a number"
if %order.note% does not start with "#", add %order.note% to %notes%
list files in '/logs', pattern "*.log", write to %files%
call SendReport to="ops@example.com", subject="Weekly report", on error call LogFailure
